dataset: DC Speed Limits Data (DDOT, sign-inventory derived)
coverage: DC roadways (from DDOT sign inventory), per side of road
notes: DDOT wiki documents a line dataset built by script from speed-limit signs snapped to centerlines, but no public service or download URL was found on the wiki or Open Data DC searches. Only related public layer found: retired 'Slow Streets' (15 mph). DC default limit is 25 mph citywide, so a flat default may suffice.
